title: Several filter arguments are combined with AND

source.quote: When there are multiple filters, they're evaluated by using the AND logical operator
source.supports: multiple filters must all be true at the same time

derivation: Red sales rows are 1, 2, 3, 5, 7; of those in 2024: rows 5 and 7 = 200 + 100 = 300. An OR would give 460 + 330 - 300 = 490.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
